I told him me and my brother was over on Spanish Island hunting yesterday afternoon, and camped on a piece of a raft we found, and about midnight he must a kicked his gun in his dreams, for it went off and shot him in the leg, and we wanted him to go over there and fix it and not say nothing about it, nor let anybody know, because we wanted to come home this evening and surprise the folks.", "sha256": "999bd8f5945636b1e5aa6dfe9230f0e972afa6997ecc70bee3c8c58d1e9ae98c", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[2]", "source_html": "The doctor was an old man; a very nice, kind-looking old man when I got him up. I told him me and my brother was over on Spanish Island hunting yesterday afternoon, and camped on a piece of a raft we found, and about midnight he must a kicked his gun in his dreams, for it went off and shot him in the leg, and we wanted him to go over there and fix it and not say nothing about it, nor let anybody know, because we wanted to come home this evening and surprise the folks."}, {"id": "043-044-0003", "tag": "p", "text": "“Who is your folks?” he says.", "sha256": "d14e33458931daec75dffb471dd7f1596ccad7e48da78f16c58e2cd2e57ae911", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[3]", "source_html": "“Who is your folks?” he says."}, {"id": "043-044-0004", "tag": "p", "text": "“The Phelpses, down yonder.”", "sha256": "37cb1a9f38c614b101e6cc92a223d2fea9be8caafbcfa12b4260f806c800a6f6", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[4]", "source_html": "“The Phelpses, down yonder.”"}, {"id": "043-044-0005", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh,” he says. And after a minute, he says:", "sha256": "07dfbfc352b66d0c9e6ab141150448f37a7a59604a9fbd8255707f0069582ae5", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[5]", "source_html": "“Oh,” he says. And after a minute, he says:"}, {"id": "043-044-0006", "tag": "p", "text": "“How’d you say he got shot?”", "sha256": "25cedff425adceb7076089fd44003dc621ed0a89194ce9653a4dd3ab88d55b3a", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[6]", "source_html": "“How’d you say he got shot?”"}, {"id": "043-044-0007", "tag": "p", "text": "“He had a dream,” I says, “and it shot him.”", "sha256": "1958414a4e7b07a71917911cce0c428b8b22e54527ebbd192ce866b09f499870", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[7]", "source_html": "“He had a dream,” I says, “and it shot him.”"}, {"id": "043-044-0008", "tag": "p", "text": "“Singular dream,” he says.", "sha256": "065a145def0e5880273c85761abafbc3d5c7b16940b9928660e4612d333166b8", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[8]", "source_html": "“Singular dream,” he says."}, {"id": "043-044-0009", "tag": "p", "text": "So he lit up his lantern, and got his saddle-bags, and we started. But when he sees the canoe he didn’t like the look of her—said she was big enough for one, but didn’t look pretty safe for two. I says:", "sha256": "748046dbbe27e47763b294998fb7864afbc88a14c6c781b3fad80dd0398b73c9", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[9]", "source_html": "So he lit up his lantern, and got his saddle-bags, and we started. But when he sees the canoe he didn’t like the look of her—said she was big enough for one, but didn’t look pretty safe for two. I says:"}, {"id": "043-044-0010", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh, you needn’t be afeard, sir, she carried the three of us easy enough.”", "sha256": "13f3cbabba6efb813c608d5e30230c856094c2e98904bab0ce16a5643e37251a", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[10]", "source_html": "“Oh, you needn’t be afeard, sir, she carried the three of us easy enough.”"}, {"id": "043-044-0011", "tag": "p", "text": "“What three?”", "sha256": "dbdd5d6ca8f9e03be59a8b38aee87dc3df76a4fa526bb5ccce26986a9fd767c2", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[11]", "source_html": "“What three?”"}, {"id": "043-044-0012", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, me and Sid, and—and—and the guns; that’s what I mean.”", "sha256": "2603d29f3973634e25bdb4dd9f41e3b7078a3cefe85c773097e4e262e64faf56", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[12]", "source_html": "“Why, me and Sid, and—and—and the guns; that’s what I mean.”"}, {"id": "043-044-0013", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh,” he says.", "sha256": "dacabfa37b8a1ef666e1ac04918317559f17959659d4a18670c23c686378418b", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[13]", "source_html": "“Oh,” he says."}, {"id": "043-044-0014", "tag": "p", "text": "But he put his foot on the gunnel and rocked her, and shook his head, and said he reckoned he’d look around for a bigger one. But they was all locked and chained; so he took my canoe, and said for me to wait till he come back, or I could hunt around further, or maybe I better go down home and get them ready for the surprise if I wanted to. But I said I didn’t; so I told him just how to find the raft, and then he started.", "sha256": "cd571ab11fb3453ac86d0a916e664d1a695e94205f0f96d9c67e6ade4bbc5f6b", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[14]", "source_html": "But he put his foot on the gunnel and rocked her, and shook his head, and said he reckoned he’d look around for a bigger one. But they was all locked and chained; so he took my canoe, and said for me to wait till he come back, or I could hunt around further, or maybe I better go down home and get them ready for the surprise if I wanted to. But I said I didn’t; so I told him just how to find the raft, and then he started."}, {"id": "043-044-0015", "tag": "p", "text": "I struck an idea pretty soon. I says to myself, spos’n he can’t fix that leg just in three shakes of a sheep’s tail, as the saying is? spos’n it takes him three or four days? What are we going to do?—lay around there till he lets the cat out of the bag? No, sir; I know what I’ll do. I’ll wait, and when he comes back if he says he’s got to go any more I’ll get down there, too, if I swim; and we’ll take and tie him, and keep him, and shove out down the river; and when Tom’s done with him we’ll give him what it’s worth, or all we got, and then let him get ashore.", "sha256": "d8cab11e1e65a958fa00701c1feb1abf0e2595ca5db63f95b642249de1ff7f58", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[15]", "source_html": "I struck an idea pretty soon. I says to myself, spos’n he can’t fix that leg just in three shakes of a sheep’s tail, as the saying is? spos’n it takes him three or four days? What are we going to do?—lay around there till he lets the cat out of the bag? No, sir; I know what I’ll do. I’ll wait, and when he comes back if he says he’s got to go any more I’ll get down there, too, if I swim; and we’ll take and tie him, and keep him, and shove out down the river; and when Tom’s done with him we’ll give him what it’s worth, or all we got, and then let him get ashore."}, {"id": "043-044-0016", "tag": "p", "text": "So then I crept into a lumber-pile to get some sleep; and next time I waked up the sun was away up over my head! I shot out and went for the doctor’s house, but they told me he’d gone away in the night some time or other, and warn’t back yet. Well, thinks I, that looks powerful bad for Tom, and I’ll dig out for the island right off. So away I shoved, and turned the corner, and nearly rammed my head into Uncle Silas’s stomach! He says:", "sha256": "0b4be841581a2cf98759c4481d3f3918a47507c83c5828a18e3d20448de97bd6", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[16]", "source_html": "So then I crept into a lumber-pile to get some sleep; and next time I waked up the sun was away up over my head! I shot out and went for the doctor’s house, but they told me he’d gone away in the night some time or other, and warn’t back yet. Well, thinks I, that looks powerful bad for Tom, and I’ll dig out for the island right off. So away I shoved, and turned the corner, and nearly rammed my head into Uncle Silas’s stomach! He says:"}, {"id": "043-044-0017", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, Tom! Where you been all this time, you rascal?”", "sha256": "5e91b8bd224ad17c91e77ad0f7e3f27037c68eeac9bc834c9f0f82ceb4c1b326", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[17]", "source_html": "“Why, Tom! Where you been all this time, you rascal?”"}, {"id": "043-044-0018", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "Uncle Silas in Danger", "sha256": "848d0088a692cbc10e8437250fb65705a99d50e0e562dc76b8c18c275a0ed549", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c41-348", "image_id": "c41-348"}, {"id": "043-044-0019", "tag": "p", "text": "“I hain’t been nowheres,” I says, “only just hunting for the runaway nigger—me and Sid.”", "sha256": "01fd62f179d0fd11fe686117ff92352e4a7d29547a745d21677a1db3beef1295", "source_location": "div.chapter[46]/*[19]", "source_html": "“I hain’t been nowheres,” I says, “only just hunting for the runaway nigger—me and Sid.”"}], "final_rows": [{"source_id": "043-044-heading", "target": "ГЛАВА XLI.", "source_sha256": "5441143001fa928de47eb16f2c5d5e57ad8fda5828718f2e6eef63cf32c679e7", "target_id": "ru-043-044-heading", "tag": "heading", "target_sha256": "ec92fdecff95e12dc14286e64711453a608c635f42b316830980764a1bf8edb5"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0001", "target": "Доктор.—Дядя Силас.—Сестра Хотчкис.—Тётя Салли в тревоге.", "source_sha256": "3da4a65a859d5edd31b51462276e0a090f4b332b2f1aa85a91fefa955e348c10", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0001", "tag": "source_argument", "target_sha256": "b1e1563f8b51b447693ac7195e6d18538a3e4fcd07e12a825a9aa347082668c6"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0002", "target": "Доктор был старик; очень славный, добрый на вид старик, когда я его поднял с постели. Я сказал ему, что мы с братом вчера после обеда охотились на Испанском острове и заночевали на куске плота, который нашли, а около полуночи он, видать, во сне двинул ногой своё ружьё, оно и бабахнуло и прострелило ему ногу, и мы хотим, чтобы он поехал туда и всё поправил, и чтоб ни слова об этом никому, и чтоб никто не знал, потому что мы хотим вернуться домой сегодня вечером и удивить домашних.", "source_sha256": "999bd8f5945636b1e5aa6dfe9230f0e972afa6997ecc70bee3c8c58d1e9ae98c", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0002", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "495d2d3a055404f098af86e175ee93bbce8118c9014742e3bb6863f390365adc"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0003", "target": "— Кто твои родные? — говорит он.", "source_sha256": "d14e33458931daec75dffb471dd7f1596ccad7e48da78f16c58e2cd2e57ae911", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0003", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "de3adc93bdd8d9964d962f77382195fd71f2347a455121494819706fed5cce88"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0004", "target": "— Фелпсы, вон там, внизу.", "source_sha256": "37cb1a9f38c614b101e6cc92a223d2fea9be8caafbcfa12b4260f806c800a6f6", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0004", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1fe557f1bfdf5be7b231c855acbd3923cf2604cfb0f975794306ef0ad7f1602b"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0005", "target": "— А, — говорит он. И через минуту говорит:", "source_sha256": "07dfbfc352b66d0c9e6ab141150448f37a7a59604a9fbd8255707f0069582ae5", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0005", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "b4570e0369997180130f03f7a2cef7e3d4acafb086b921ded4f042f9c856e8be"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0006", "target": "— Как, ты говоришь, его ранило?", "source_sha256": "25cedff425adceb7076089fd44003dc621ed0a89194ce9653a4dd3ab88d55b3a", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0006", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "9668d5cea056c0391586764bbf400723b14cc76de9a60bb3ed2e52e5ebdde409"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0007", "target": "— Ему приснился сон, — говорю я, — и он его подстрелил.", "source_sha256": "1958414a4e7b07a71917911cce0c428b8b22e54527ebbd192ce866b09f499870", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0007", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d9046de01691db8b223869e8992a21b6976e7db6c856e87212793e3e2e880204"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0008", "target": "— Странный сон, — говорит он.", "source_sha256": "065a145def0e5880273c85761abafbc3d5c7b16940b9928660e4612d333166b8", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0008", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "83fe6d9991c8a668dd9c41c6d14d8db26f0825d73b1e3238b0127e4da845ccf4"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0009", "target": "Тогда он зажёг фонарь, взял свои седельные сумки, и мы пошли. Но когда он увидел каноэ, оно ему не понравилось — он сказал, что для одного оно достаточно велико, а для двоих как будто не очень надёжно. Я говорю:", "source_sha256": "748046dbbe27e47763b294998fb7864afbc88a14c6c781b3fad80dd0398b73c9", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0009", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7bcc5ea206a8ac3acaaa97283b959187a02d0a7f8906c8e3c33f4cb0907e2c98"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0010", "target": "— Да что вы, сэр, бояться нечего, она нас троих легко возила.", "source_sha256": "13f3cbabba6efb813c608d5e30230c856094c2e98904bab0ce16a5643e37251a", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0010", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "f241b6ae2676a5de54ce02cd9e92438f1dafe8ff6d1b426e675f9ae60f9d93e1"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0011", "target": "— Каких троих?", "source_sha256": "dbdd5d6ca8f9e03be59a8b38aee87dc3df76a4fa526bb5ccce26986a9fd767c2", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0011", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "09fa23bb53bc5fd7441b9c56c26a36fab7313b837f97b398cca27c1c853d9a59"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0012", "target": "— Ну, меня с Сидом, и… и… и ружья; это я и хотел сказать.", "source_sha256": "2603d29f3973634e25bdb4dd9f41e3b7078a3cefe85c773097e4e262e64faf56", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0012", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "4c4d3027d362dffa11ae74cf03bb92eed5c2120eef88b9c12a70de6ac0a24777"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0013", "target": "— А, — говорит он.", "source_sha256": "dacabfa37b8a1ef666e1ac04918317559f17959659d4a18670c23c686378418b", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0013", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "3ca2927b86a762aec798f2260f7a34a615327c38c3a93ea7b567dc7e78bf6bf5"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0014", "target": "Но он поставил ногу на борт, покачал лодку, потряс головой и сказал, что, пожалуй, поищет что-нибудь побольше. Но все лодки были заперты и закованы цепями; тогда он взял моё каноэ и сказал, чтобы я подождал, пока он вернётся, или поискал ещё где-нибудь, или, может, мне лучше пойти домой и подготовить их к сюрпризу, если захочу. Но я сказал, что не хочу; и объяснил ему, как найти плот, и он отправился.", "source_sha256": "cd571ab11fb3453ac86d0a916e664d1a695e94205f0f96d9c67e6ade4bbc5f6b", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0014", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "93ae6426396801c079c0f529ba894339c09fae1037782bd95028ada048eaf211"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0015", "target": "Скоро мне пришла в голову мысль. Я сказал себе: а вдруг он не сумеет вылечить эту ногу в один миг, как говорится? А вдруг ему понадобится три-четыре дня? Что нам тогда делать? Сидеть там, пока он не выдаст тайну? Нет уж, сэр; я знаю, что я сделаю. Подожду, и когда он вернётся, если скажет, что ему надо ехать ещё куда-нибудь, я тоже туда доберусь, хоть вплавь; и мы возьмём да свяжем его, и задержим, и отчалим вниз по реке; а когда Том с ним развяжется, мы заплатим ему, сколько он стоит, или всё, что у нас есть, а потом высадим на берег.", "source_sha256": "d8cab11e1e65a958fa00701c1feb1abf0e2595ca5db63f95b642249de1ff7f58", "target_id": "ru-043-044-0015", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "018b709f5b569321ab31fa4f63002040dd7270a28c56edf6ff009883eba3f651"}, {"source_id": "043-044-0016", "target": "Потом я залез в штабель досок поспать; а когда проснулся, солнце было уже высоко над головой! Я вскочил и побежал к дому доктора, но мне сказали, что он ушёл куда-то ночью и ещё не вернулся. Ну, думаю, для Тома это очень скверно, и надо сейчас же удирать на остров.
